local self = require('openmw.self')
local Actor = require('openmw.types').Actor
local announced = false
return {{ engineHandlers = {{ onUpdate = function()
    if self.contentFile ~= 'oblivion.esm' or self.recordId:sub(-5) ~= '25200' then return end
    assert(Actor.objectIsInstance(self))
    assert(not require('openmw.types').NPC.objectIsInstance(self))
    assert(self.type.baseType == Actor)
    self.type.setStance(self, self.type.STANCE.Weapon)
    self.controls.block = true
    if not announced then
        print('M15 block victim controls admitted: record=' .. self.recordId .. ' actor=' .. self.id)

end }} }}
